ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels; high-intensity pixels are concentrated on the distal regions of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous mottled high-intensity blob on the left distal lobe spanning the outer third; similar high-intensity mottling on the right distal lobe; solid low-intensity (black) region across the central span and peduncle interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 50 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge; distinct high-amplitude (5-10 pixel depth) jagged irregular peaks located on the right lobe's outer margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of roughly circular, high-intensity pixel spots (potential barnacle scars) concentrated on the extreme right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-5 parallel, vertically-oriented dark linear streaks (rake marks) visible within the white mottled region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The extreme left distal tip exhibits a ragged, irregular geometry with significant high-contrast textural disruptions, suggesting prior physical trauma or heavy barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark C-shaped marking (arch-shaped pigment) located within the white mottled field of the upper-left lobe.
